brief.zh: 已知「今天是周六 → (下雨 → 我休息)」和「下雨」，证出「今天是周六 → 我休息」。
brief.en: Given “today is Saturday → (it rains → I rest)” and “it rains”, prove “today is Saturday → I rest”.

hint.zh: 框元件上的「假设」选「今天是周六」。
hint.en: On the box, set “Assume” to “today is Saturday”.

hint.zh: 在框里放两块套用：先把第一张已知套用到假设上，再套用到「下雨」上，结果接到框的「结论」。
hint.en: Put two Applies in the box: apply the first given to the assumption, then the result to “it rains”, and wire that to the box’s “Conclusion”.

t.zh: 地基的第二块元件是假设框。人会这样想：「假设今天是周六。那下雨我就休息；现在确实下雨，所以我休息。所以，如果今天是周六，那么我休息。」
t.en: The foundation’s second part is the assumption box. A person thinks: “Suppose today is Saturday. Then if it rains I rest; it is raining, so I rest. So if today is Saturday, then I rest.”

t.zh: 框元件上选要假设的话，框左上角给出它；在框里证出的东西接到框右上角的「结论」，框外就得到「如果 假设，那么 结论」。点一下框里，新放的元件就落在框里。
t.en: Choose on the box what to assume, and its top left gives it; wire what you prove inside to “Conclusion” at its top right, and outside you get “if the assumption, then the conclusion”. Click inside the box and new parts land there.

t.zh: 套用用掉一句「如果…那么…」，框造出一句「如果…那么…」：地基就是这一对。
t.en: Apply uses an “if … then …” up, the box makes one: the foundation is this pair.

after.zh: 一个框、两次套用。真实的证明器 Lean 的内核也是从这一对开始的：框是 λ，套用是函数应用。
after.en: One box and two Applies. The kernel of Lean, a real prover, starts from this pair too: the box is λ, Apply is function application.
